_comment: Owners file of the E3/E4/E5a/E6 batch of the Consortium v2 plan (knowledge/project/consortium-v2-plan.md; design check .local/consortium/v2/e6/design-check.md section 3, gitignored in the main checkout). Path -> stream per chunk: one owner per path per chunk; a path may change hands between chunks. Patterns are repo-relative: '*' stays within a folder, '**' crosses folders. Chunks run in order; streams inside a chunk run in parallel. scripts/plan-owners.test.mjs fails a path two streams own in one chunk; node scripts/plan/owners.mjs check <chunk> <stream> <base> fails a stream diff outside its rows. A file found needed mid-build is requested from the main agent, never taken.

main.duty: commit 0 (design check section 5): devDependency pins and script slots, fold.ts leaf, additive types, test-seam.d.ts, lazy chunk roles, expect-fail helper, failing tests, shards, ADR-1/2/6

K1.duty: views/kit (sheet frame, flags, names, icons, format, page reader); sheets import the kit, not Details (C4); matrix-parts.tsx (C3); page/zoneLabel out of Start (C2); Start and tracks use fold.ts with Add's matcher (A9; removes the E6-1 marker); one spanOf; Details re-exports of store actions removed

S1.duty: one declaration state/schema.ts driving Consortium, Snapshot/SNAP_KEYS, ShareInput/shareState and the watcher lists; save/restore and link round-trip node tests per field (probe P-E6c first)

R1.duty: nearest.ts leaf (C1); zones.ts one zone list and order (correction.mjs, climates.ts and the installer agree; installer refuses an unknown zone id; removes the zones marker); flagsOf beside conflicts.ts

CI.duty: ci.yml (changes, 1 check+install:climate+unit+policy, 2 build:browser-test artifact, 3 four shards, 4 build+budgets+smoke+axe+vectors, gate, deploy, live); nightly.yml; .githooks (lib.sh, pre-commit, pre-push); .node-version; version marker and its _headers line (A15-A20)

Q1.duty: dependency-cruiser L1-L9 at A25 severities (probe P-E4a first); knip and jscpd configs and key baselines; scripts/quality/ratchet.mjs (the check:arch/check:dup/check:dead wrapper); boundary test extended to src/lib/climate; axe smoke with a baseline

V.duty: A21-A23: committed lookup.json + .sha256 + synthetic-expected.json; climate-reader.test.mjs reads synthetic-expected.json; climate-vectors.test.mjs (removes its marker); goldens.json and make-goldens.mjs deleted (probe P-E5a first)

R2.duty: rules/list-query.ts (Add and PlantList; removes the list-query marker), rules/suggest-block.ts, rules/site-fit.ts + SiteFitMessage; kit/flags renders only; loadRangeRule() and role range (A10; P5-27b blocks range); node tests of the three rules; state.ts uses zones.ts (zoneOfSiteId, siteIdOf) instead of its own lower-casing, and climateZones moves from types.ts into zones.ts (R1 hand-off)

S2.duty: memory.ts -> state/{persist,restore,arrival,draft,suggest-wait}.ts (re-exports kept for R2's files until chunk 5); location orchestration -> state/location.ts; location.tsx renders only; place-search.ts without signals (A12); one country-source enum; one computed climate shown; the place-search input gets an em width equal to its current width so a late font cannot move the rows after it, and the late-font layout test gets N2's box check back (font fix hand-off)

Q2.duty: ast-grep rule: no new Intl.NumberFormat outside src/islands/consortium/format.ts, with a rule test; baselines regenerated after K1

K3.duty: Details split: first-run router views/Sheets.tsx and lazy views/details/Details.tsx (probe P-E6a first); one loader lazyPart with onFail closeSheet (A6); __ctFaults read inline (A13); prefetch trigger; L1-L7, L12 (removes the E6-3, E6-4, E6-5 markers); SheetFrame takes onClose and toast props, with views/Sheets.tsx its only caller, so views/kit/sheet.tsx imports neither store.ts nor Toast.tsx (L5; K1 plan check)

S3.duty: explicit start() from main.ts for the module-level effects of store.ts and state/*; guarded dynamic import of test-hook.ts (A13); test-hook.ts writes __ctFaults; node tests import state with no effects running; start() in main.ts calls provideLocationStep explicitly (S2 hand-off: today it is a side effect of importing views/location/load.ts); state/persist.ts siteId uses zones.ts siteIdOf instead of lower-casing by hand (R1 hand-off)

Q3.duty: boundary test extended to src/lib/location (A27); L1 lib-no-ui flipped to error

R4.duty: one placement origin {list, kind} on Taxon; factAt(taxon, site, period) for ADR-6's facts; loadSuggest() (A11) and Swap through it; L8, L9 (removes the E6-6, E6-7 markers); the ct:matrix -> ct:first-view line in Matrix.tsx (B4's duty handed over); range-marks.ts loses its placedFrom.toLowerCase() with placedFrom (R1 hand-off)

B4.duty: A5 modulepreload filter; roles details/sheets/later/suggest/range filled and merged with the feature roles; A14 per-chunk caps (first run stays 43); ct:first-view in the timing script and tests (A7); timing ratchet (A8); CSS-on-lazy-chunk assertion; L5, L11 (removes the E6-2 marker)

main.duty: exit: memory.ts re-exports removed and consumers re-pointed; first run lowered to the measured value (<= 40 KB); dependency-cruiser L2/L5/L6/L8 and no-circular to error; knip baseline regenerated (dead plantName etc. deleted); zero expected-fail markers; concepts; remove forwarders store.ts DEFAULT_SITE/Consortium re-exports, memory.ts plantName; shell.css:77 drops var(--font-body); remove forwarders views/location/keep.ts, load.ts re-exports, location.tsx re-exports (settle, useMyLocation, searchPlace) and the memory.ts barrel; Start.tsx and PoolSlot.tsx read climateShown (state/persist.ts) instead of computing the shown climate (S2/R2 seam); location.tsx:85 uses it too
